title: Atlas Labs reports growth and merger
text: Atlas Labs announced a merger with Cedar Works. Profit growth improved after strong software sales.

title: Harbor Council reviews regional inflation
text: Harbor Council announced an interest rate policy review as inflation and economic growth slowed. The regional economy faces risk from declining demand.

title: Cedar Works launches research software
text: Cedar Works launched new software for technology research. The product launch improved efficiency and delivered positive results.

title: River District announces transport policy
text: River District announced a policy change in government legislation for public transport. The council approved regulation following a public election debate.

title: Atlas Labs opens a technology workshop
text: Atlas Labs launched a software workshop with Cedar Works. Technology researchers welcomed strong growth and improved access.
